Pooled result

Estimate withdrawn. WITHDRAWN 2026-08-18. A COMPOSITE POOLED WITH TRIALS THAT REGISTERED FUNCTIONAL ENDPOINTS. Registered primaries read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: AFFIRM-AHF (NCT02937454) 'HF Hospitalizations and CV Death'; IRONMAN (NCT02642562) 'CV mortality or hospitalisation for worsening heart failure'; CONFIRM-HF (NCT01453608) 'CHANGE IN SIX MINUTE WALK TEST from baseline to week 24'; FAIR-HF (NCT00520780) 'SELF-REPORTED PATIENT GLOBAL ASSESSMENT and NYHA functional status'. Two trials contribute an event composite; the other two registered FUNCTIONAL endpoints, and this object carried event counts for them (33/152 and 17/304) that are not their registered primaries. A composite pooled with something else entirely. REPLACED, NOT MERELY WITHDRAWN -- see the harmonised k=2 block.

Pooled result

Estimate withdrawn. WITHDRAWN 2026-08-18, HOURS AFTER IT WAS BUILT. Correcting an arm inversion in the IRONMAN row changed this pool from RR 0.7987 (0.7490-0.8517) with I2=0% to RR 0.976 (0.624-1.527) with I2=97.9%, AND THE TWO TRIALS NOW POINT IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS: AFFIRM-AHF 0.776, IRONMAN 1.225. IRONMAN FAVOURING THE CONTROL ARM CONTRADICTS THE PUBLISHED TRIAL. Combined with the fact that NCT02642562 POSTS NO RESULTS SECTION AT ALL -- so these counts did not come from the registry and this object never recorded where they did -- the IRONMAN row cannot be relied on in either direction. A POOL AT I2=97.9% BUILT ON AN UNATTRIBUTED ROW WHOSE DIRECTION CONTRADICTS ITS OWN TRIAL IS NOT AN ESTIMATE. Withdrawn until the IRONMAN counts are sourced.

Methods — synthesis

For multiple trial-declared outcomes: HF Hospitalizations and CV Death | Number of Deaths, a random-effects model was fitted with the DerSimonian-Laird inverse-variance on extracted effect estimates estimator.1

For cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure, a random-effects model was fitted with the REML estimator.2

Methodological decisions follow not recorded on the page this object was extracted from, version not recorded on the page this object was extracted from, and the sections relied on are listed in the object rather than cited generically.3

This review reports against PRISMA 2020. A screening record is held on this object and the flow it supports is shown in the Methods. The completed PRISMA checklist and FLOW diagram are not held here: the venue requires them deposited in an approved repository with a DOI cited in the Data Availability Statement, and minting that DOI is an author action rather than a build step.1
